user.title: Configure the new AI image generator

data_description.model: The image model on your server (e.g. gpt-image-1, dall-e-3, or your Stable Diffusion / Gemini model)
data_description.image_size: e.g. 1024x1024. 'auto' lets the server decide. You can type a custom size.
data_description.image_quality: 'auto' sends nothing. Use low/medium/high for gpt-image, standard/hd for dall-e-3.
data_description.image_format: png is the default and works everywhere. Only change it if your server supports it.
data_description.image_response_format: b64_json works on most local servers. Use 'omit' for gpt-image-1 style servers that reject this setting, or 'url' if your server only returns links.
data_description.support_attachments: Lets automations/services send a photo along with the prompt (uses /images/edits). Your server must support it.
data_description.save_images: Every image gets a copy written to the folder below, on top of Home Assistant's normal handling.
data_description.save_path: Folder must be inside /config/www or /media, or listed in allowlist_external_dirs. Files in /config/www show up at /local/...
data_description.filename_template: Placeholders: {date} {time} {timestamp} {slug} {name} {model}. The file extension is added automatically.
